svg.text: Rectangle X 34 to 125, Y -56 to 56. Extrude 4 (Z 0 to 4).
Cut a circle R84 at (0,0) (same as the cover's top hole).
Ø10.2, 3.1 deep from the BOTTOM face, at X 113, Y ±40. Leaves
Overlaps the cover cutout by 6 on 3 sides. Magnets hold it
1. Origin = turret pan axis, Z0 = bottom of the hatch (sits on the cover roof).
2. Printed holes come out ~0.2 small: test-print one hole first.
3. Print top face down so the magnet pockets face up.
